description: Compute the federal SALT deduction cap under 26 USC 164(b)(6) and (b)(7) for a tax year, filing status, and modified adjusted gross income. Returns the cap and the steps, not the deduction. Years before 2018 are not_covered. MAGI is used to compute and is not written to the usage log.

filing_status.description: single, married_filing_jointly, married_filing_separately, head_of_household, or qualifying_surviving_spouse. Aliases: mfj, mfs, hoh, qss.

magi.description: Modified adjusted gross income: AGI plus IRC 911, 931, and 933 exclusions. Integer or decimal string, at most 8 decimal places.

tax_year.description: Tax year. 2018 through 2024 use the prior flat cap. 2025 and later use section 164(b)(7).

name: salt_cap
title: Federal SALT cap
